body.objective: Complete the direct four-dimensional Lee--Wald current of the generic polar additional Weyl--Maxwell branches on the compact product, closing the principal parity gap in the Einstein/extra bridge.
body.stop_condition: Import EINSTEIN_MAXWELL_WEYL_POLAR_FULL_TENSOR, EINSTEIN_MAXWELL_WEYL_POLAR_PHYSICAL_COMPLETION, EINSTEIN_MAXWELL_WEYL_POLAR_LEE_WALD_GATE and the axial direct Lee--Wald completion by exact hashes. Starting independently from the four-dimensional Weyl--Maxwell action and its curvature-momentum Lee--Wald potential, retain the complete delta(nabla C) contribution and derive the polar current for generic physical ell>=2 and compact momentum. Pull it to the exact q-primary Einstein image and both p-primary additional summands, compute every same-shell Gram and cross block, inertia, radical, normalization and exceptional collision locus, and compare the result with the existing reduced polar-current gate without using that gate as the producer. State whether the additional polar block is nonradical and how its invariant current data compare with the axial block; do not call a classical sign a quantum norm. Supply an independent Green-identity or covariant-variation verifier, Einstein--Maxwell and flat controls, sign/normalization/omitted-delta(nabla C) mutations, strict schema, receipt, report, Paper 92 update and atlas fragment.

body.forbid: no reduced polar gate reused as the independent derivation; no axial-to-polar inference by parity alone; no omitted delta(nabla C) term; no fixture-only ell=2 theorem called generic; no final residual, causal boundary, particle, positivity or unitarity promotion
